results.title: Multimodal input | ElevenLabs Documentation
results.snippet: Multimodal input settings control extra ways users can send information to the agent beyond speech. They live in the agent's Advanced tab, under Multimodal input.

results.title: elevenlabs.io
results.snippet: ### FileInputConfig - `enabled` (boolean, optional, default: true) — When enabled, users may attach images, PDFs, or text files in chat when the LLM supports multimodal input. - `max_files_in_memory` (integer, optional, default: 10) — Number of most-recent files kept in memory during a conversation.

results.title: Slack | ElevenLabs Documentation
results.snippet: File attachments are only forwarded when the agent's LLM supports multimodal input — image input and/or document (PDF) input, depending on the file type. In the agent configuration, open the Agent tab and check the selected model.
